arabic_html:
وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ
ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ ۞
translation: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters worthy of resolve.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: justice permits a recompense equal to the wrong — the law says so plainly. Yet the verse turns and calls patience and pardon the matters worth resolving on.
